description: U.S. Sen. Jim Risch defeated his challengers with nearly 67% of the vote, or 156,199 ballots cast in his favor, according to results as of 10:30 a.m. Wednesday with all precincts reported. “Our work ahead is critical, and I will never stop fighting to protect Idaho’s way of life,” Risch said in an emailed statement. …

title: Risch wins Republican primary for U.S. Senate - Senator Risch
